ubhatovibhaṅga.p: [Ubhato+vibhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 Ubhato Vibhaṅga, Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga  , Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga. (Ubhato means both sides or ways). (Vibhaṅga means analysis (or) classification).
pn: Ubhatovibhaṅga. A collective term, comprehending the Bhikkhuvibhaṅga and the Bhikkhunīvibhaṅga of the Vinayapiṭaka. It consists of sixty-four bhāṇavāras (DN-a.i.13; Vin-a.i.15). In the nine-fold division of the Buddha’s teachings – Sutta, geyya, etc. the Ubhatovibhaṅga falls into the category of Sutta (DN-a.i.23; Gv.57. 43). Sometimes the word seems to be used as varia lectio for Ubhatovinaya, e.g., Vin.ii.287; see also Dpv.vii.43.
